description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing 4 tools including health, list_ad_groups, list_campaigns, list_keywords.

capabilities.archival_reason: Repository or package returned HTTP 404/Not Found

tool_signatures.name: health
tool_signatures.description: Check if the aapl-ads-mcp server is running and reachable. Use this to verify the MCP connection before making API calls. No ASA authentication is required — returns server name, version, and current timestamp.

tool_signatures.name: list_ad_groups
tool_signatures.description: List ad groups within a specific Apple Search Ads campaign. Requires ASA authentication; read-only. Returns ad group metadata (id, name, status, default bid, automated keyword opt-in) but not performance metrics — use get_ad_group_report for metrics. Supports pagination via limit/offset; default limit 20, max 1000.

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign whose ad groups to list. Obtain from list_campaigns.

limit.description: Max ad groups to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: ID of the campaign whose ad groups to list. Obtain from list_campaigns.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max ad groups to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

tool_signatures.name: list_campaigns
tool_signatures.description: List all campaigns in the configured Apple Search Ads organization. Requires ASA authentication; read-only. Returns campaign metadata (id, name, status, budget, country, channel type) but not performance metrics — use get_campaign_report for metrics. Optionally filter by status. Supports pagination via limit/offset; default limit 20, max 1000.

status.description: Filter results to campaigns with this status. Omit to return all statuses.

limit.description: Max campaigns to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max campaigns to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter results to campaigns with this status. Omit to return all statuses.

tool_signatures.name: list_keywords
tool_signatures.description: List targeting keywords for a specific Apple Search Ads ad group. Requires ASA authentication; read-only. Returns keyword metadata (text, match type BROAD/EXACT, bid amount, status) but not performance metrics — use get_keyword_report for metrics. Supports pagination via limit/offset; default limit 20, max 1000.

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign that contains the ad group. Obtain from list_campaigns.

adGroupId.description: ID of the ad group whose keywords to list. Obtain from list_ad_groups.

limit.description: Max keywords to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: adGroupId
parameters.description: ID of the ad group whose keywords to list. Obtain from list_ad_groups.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: ID of the campaign that contains the ad group. Obtain from list_campaigns.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max keywords to return (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.
